newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Command says Ravva output 14,000 bopd.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Command says Ravva output 14,000 bopd.

text.p: Command Petroleum Ltd said oil production from the Ravva oil field, offshore India has averaged 14,000 barrels of oil per day (bopd) since production resumed on August 28 following a 12 day shut in period.
"Since resumption, production has averaged 14,000 bopd and has reached a high of 15,970 bopd," the company said.
Last month, Command said RD-3, a water injection well drilled in the area indicated additional reserves of oil in the Ravva field.
Command said the RD-3 well had been completed and the well would be initially flowed as an oil producer.

"The rig will move to the RE platform, 3.7 kilometres northeast of the Ravva D platform where it will drill the RE-1 well, planned to be an oil producer in a near crestal position in the Ravva 9-36 block. This will be the first well drilled by Command in the 9-36 block," Command said.

Participating interests in Ravva are India's state-owned Oil & Natural Gas Corp Ltd 40 percent, Command Petroleum (India) Pty Ltd (operator) 22.5 percent, Videocon Group unit Videocon Petroleum Ltd 25 percent and Marubeni Corp unit Ravva Oil (Singapore) Pte Ltd 12.5 percent.
